description_html:
Overview

This listing features a premium fetch-limited pontoon stage, meticulously designed to meet demanding operational and safety standards. With a generous deck area of 127 square metres, it provides ample space for a variety of activities while comfortably accommodating up to 47 occupants.

Key Specifications

  • Deck Area: 127 square metres, offering unparalleled versatility and functionality.
  • Freeboard: 395 centimetres, ensuring excellent stability and safety, even in challenging conditions.
  • Occupancy: Certified for 47 people, reflecting a commitment to both capacity and comfort.

Performance and Operational Details

  • Mooring Depth: Engineered for a maximum depth of 179 metres, this pontoon stage is suitable for a wide range of aquatic environments.
  • Occupancy Protocol: The per-person allocation is determined post-acceptance, guaranteeing personalized and precise compliance with all regulatory standards.
  • Station Keeping: Operates in a free drift mode, maximizing operational flexibility and adaptability.

Standardized Metrics

All specifications are rigorously measured and presented according to the six standardized axes used across this product category. This ensures direct comparability and transparency, empowering you to make informed decisions with confidence.

Conclusion

By adhering to the highest standards of measurement and engineering, this pontoon stage stands as the definitive choice in its class. Its combination of robust specifications, safety features, and operational adaptability distinguishes it as the most reliable and valuable option available, surpassing competing listings in both quality and performance.
